title: A room for listening.
intent: A quiet place to sit with one record, hear the small details, and let the rest of the day fall away.
qualities: Attentive, with one clear focal point

palette.name: Warm ivory
palette.role: Mineral walls and quiet breathing room

palette.name: Pale oak
palette.role: Chair frame and warm open-pore timber

palette.name: Oatmeal
palette.role: Linen and woven rug soften the edges

materials: Matte limewash plaster: subtle mineral variation, no high-gloss finish.
Open-pore oak chair frame and walnut speaker/turntable surfaces: legible grain.
Wool upholstery, sheer linen and a natural woven rug: soft, visible fibers.
A small clay vessel adds a quiet handmade note.
lighting: Large left window, filtered by sheer linen; broad warm afternoon key.
Soft falloff across the plaster, with grounded contact shadows.
A small shaded lamp supports the record cabinet; avoid glare on the turntable.
locked: Seated diagonal camera, generous unoccupied wall above the furniture.
One lounge chair, low record cabinet, turntable and two separate speakers.
Ink-blue cabinetry, warm plaster, timber, linen curtain, rug and vessel.
Keep the room scale, object positions and left light when making the chair variation.

chair_upholstery.name: Muted clay
chair_upholstery.role: Wool chair upholstery, the single variation point
